rationale: Base station storage was at 98% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402 and preventing new events from being recorded. All devices were online and live view worked, ruling out network/link faults. The standard L1 fix (enabling Loop Recording) was applied and the customer confirmed new events are now saving, resolving the issue.

args.query: E-402 storage full loop recording fix procedure

args.action: Ask the customer to open Base Station Settings > Storage and enable Loop Recording. This will automatically overwrite the oldest clips when storage is full, so the E-402 warning stops recurring. (If they prefer to keep all clips, they should export important clips first, then format the storage.)

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
